title: Private deployment optimization automation: safe defaults, offline-safe apply/rollback, and policy enforcement
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add automation that recommends and safely applies batching and KV-cache profiling adjustments for Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments while respecting offline environments and customer policy constraints. The feature must surface conservative defaults, provide a non-disruptive dry-run mode, allow safe rollback, and enforce org-specific policies (e.g., max batch sizes, disallowed kernel patches) before applying changes. Target is to reduce per-token cost on typical workloads by 15-30% without affecting SLOs for latency or correctness.
acceptance_criteria: A recommendation engine runs locally or in control plane and generates batching and cache tuning suggestions with estimated cost/latency delta for a given workload profile

Default recommendation profile for Private deployments is conservative and documented (max_batch_size <= 8, kv_cache_ttl default <= 60s for sensitive workloads, enable_prefix_cache=false by default for air-gapped installs)
Config apply has a dry-run mode that simulates kernel/batching changes and emits an explicit rollback plan before changes are committed
Applies and rollbacks work with no control-plane access (offline mode) by packaging a signed, versioned bundle that the on-prem agent validates and applies locally
Policy checks run pre-apply and block changes that violate org policies; violations produce an actionable error with remediation steps
Audit events are emitted for recommendation generation, approval, apply, and rollback with trace IDs and operator identity; events are encrypted at rest using customer KMS when configured
End-to-end tests show cost reduction in benchmark workloads while 95th percentile latency stays within configured SLO +/- 10%
Documentation and console UI show reasons, risk score, and a one-click rollback for applied changes
implementation_notes: Recommendation engine will use sampled telemetry (histogram of seq lengths, token rates, KV cache hit rates) collected into a compact profile that is safe for PII-sensitive configs; default profile size < 256KB

Offline mode: control plane produces a signed 'tuning bundle' containing proposed runtime config diff, a dry-run simulation report, and a rollback manifest. On-prem agent validates bundle signature with customer-provided public key before applying
Safe defaults: create a 'private-conservative' tuning profile with conservative batch limits and disabled speculative optimizations. This profile is the default for any org without explicit opt-in

Policy enforcement: integrate with existing policy engine (OPA-lite) embedded in the on-prem agent. Policies expressed as simple allow/deny rules and parameter thresholds. SDK will expose policy templates for security/compliance teams

Atomic apply/rollback: apply changes in two-phase commit: stage -> health-check (synthetic traffic) -> commit. If health-check fails, auto-execute rollback manifest. Health-check uses local test harness and key SLO probes
Telemetry export is optional and defaults to off for private installs. If telemetry disabled, recommendation engine operates in 'profile-only' mode using local profiling run triggered by operator
Keep binaries and kernel patches out of bundled changes for offline installs unless org explicitly allows 'kernel_update=true' in their policy (requires signed approval)
Expose CLI and Console flows: CLI for fully offline apply, Console for managed private installs with control-plane-assisted approvals
rollout_plan: Week 1: Feature branch + unit tests. Deliver recommendation engine prototype using synthetic profiles
Week 2: Implement signed tuning bundle format and offline apply validation in on-prem agent
Week 3: Integrate OPA-lite policy checks and add conservative default profile; internal dogfood on staging private cluster
Week 4: End-to-end tests with synthetic and customer-provided traces; QA, security review, and documentation
Gradual rollout: opt-in beta for select private customers, monitor telemetry and SLOs for 2 weeks, then enable auto-suggest defaults for wider set
Fallback: immediate rollback route in Console and CLI; if >3 customers report regressions, pause automation and issue patch
test_plan: Unit tests for recommendation heuristics and bundle generation
Integration tests: apply/rollback in online and offline modes against a local on-prem agent emulator
E2E perf tests: run benchmark traces (chat, codegen, embeddings) to measure cost and latency deltas
Policy tests: inject policy violations and confirm pre-apply blocking and clear error messages
Security tests: signature verification, KMS-wrapped audit logs, and offline agent sandboxing
Chaos test: simulate agent process crash during stage and ensure rollback manifest executes on restart
qa_checks: Health-check synthetic traffic must run at customer-configured concurrency and validate token-level latency percentiles
Rollback manifests must be validated by CI with a dry-run apply path
Audit log entries present for each lifecycle step and include trace ID and operator email
Policy templates reviewed by Security/Compliance team and included in release notes
Documentation includes CLI examples, sample policies, and recommended conservative profiles
